candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s; order in turn times out calling payment. Payment authorization latency (~2s) propagates up, causing checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side spans are only seen from caller perspective; no payment service telemetry to confirm its internal cause.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by transport ReadTimeouts on order and payment calls at ~2s, with payment authorization taking ~2s while inventory/redis are fast. Consistent downstream latency propagating to gateway checkout.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces/metrics showing authorization latency and its internal cause
Order service logs/metrics confirming where the ~2s timeout originates
Configured client timeout values for gateway->order and order->payment calls
